question: Are L9H1/H4/H7 subject writes necessary, not merely sufficient, for the block9-mediated part of the live L8H1-to-L11H3 response?

frozen_design.population_and_writer: Same capability-passed v4 A1/A2 population and exact L8H1 cue-to-subject intervention.

necessity_arms.writer_native: Live writer with no L9 clamp.
necessity_arms.clamp_greedy: During the live writer run, restore L9H1/H4/H7 head outputs at subject destinations to their native-base values.
necessity_arms.clamp_complement: Restore the other six L9 heads at the same destinations.
necessity_arms.clamp_all: Restore all nine L9 heads at the same destinations.
necessity_arms.base_self_clamp: Apply the all-head restoration without the writer as an inertness control.

frozen_design.outcomes: Behavioral donor recovery and frozen rank-two H3 response norm. Compare each removal against clamp-all, not against the much larger direct writer effect.

predictions.pred_a_authority_capture_self_clamp_and_: Authorities and capability hold; attention reconstruction <=5e-4; base self-clamp error <=1e-4; coverage, finiteness, and price hold.
predictions.pred_b_complete_l9_removal_is_material: Clamp-all removes at least 3% of the live writer's signed behavioral effect and a nonzero H3 rank-two response in both panels.
predictions.pred_c_greedy_set_is_necessary_for_h3_re: Greedy-set removal accounts for at least 90% of the clamp-all projected H3 response removal in both panels.
predictions.pred_d_complement_is_unnecessary_for_h3_: Six-head-complement removal accounts for at most 15% of clamp-all projected H3 response removal in both panels.
predictions.pred_e_greedy_set_is_necessary_for_behav: Greedy-set removal is within 20% of clamp-all signed behavioral removal in both panels.

decision: screen if all pass; redundant if A/B hold but necessity is distributed; null if complete removal is immaterial; invalid if A fails.
